verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management platform, so reviewing adverse-media matches is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows generic customer screening and alert dispositioning (docs-23) and ingesting monitoring-system alerts into cases (docs-1). Nothing in the pack documents adverse-media matches, linked media evidence, or risk categorization of those matches, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can review adverse-media matches with linked evidence and risk categories
